name: center
purpose: The #center method is used to center the HtmlDialog relative to the active model window.

name: close
purpose: The #close method is used to close a dialog box.

name: execute_script
purpose: The #execute_script method is used to execute a JavaScript string on the html dialog asynchronously.

name: get_content_size
purpose: The #get_content_size method is used to get the content size of the HtmlDialog, in logical pixels.

name: get_position
purpose: The #get_position method is used to get the position of the HtmlDialog relative to the screen, in logical pixels.

name: get_size
purpose: The #get_size method is used to get the outer frame size of the HtmlDialog, in logical pixels.

name: hide
purpose: The #hide method is used to hide a dialog box without closing it.

name: set_can_close
purpose: The #set_can_close method is used to attach a block that is executed just before closing, this block has to return a boolean, if the block returns false the close will be canceled.

name: set_content_size
purpose: The #set_content_size method is used to set the content size of the HtmlDialog, in logical pixels.

name: set_file
purpose: The #set_file method is used to identify a local HTML file to display in the HtmlDialog.

name: set_html
purpose: The #set_html method is used to load a HtmlDialog with a string of provided HTML.

name: set_on_closed
purpose: The #set_on_closed method is used to attach a block that will be executed when a dialog is already in the process of closing, do any last minute operations within this block such as releasing resources or performing cleanup tasks.

name: set_position
purpose: The #set_position method is used to set the position of the HtmlDialog relative to the screen, in pixels.

name: set_size
purpose: The #set_size method is used to set the outer frame size of the HtmlDialog, in pixels.

name: set_url
purpose: The #set_url method is used to load a HtmlDialog with the content at a specific URL.

name: show
purpose: The #show method is used to display a non-modal dialog box.

name: show_modal
purpose: The #show_modal method is used to display a modal dialog box.

name: visible?
purpose: The #visible? method is useful to tell if the dialog is shown and still alive, if the dialog is minimized or not visible on the screen this will still return `true`.

name: initialize
purpose: Creates a new Notification object.
syntax: ["#initialize(sketchup_extension, message = nil, icon_name = nil, icon_tooltip = nil) ⇒ UI::Notification"]

name: icon_name
purpose: Gets the icon name, this is the path that will be used to get the icon from the file system path.

name: icon_name=
purpose: Sets the icon path, this icon will be loaded from the path give, the path has to be a local filesystem path.

name: icon_tooltip
purpose: Gets the icon Tooltip, this is the string that appear when the mouse is over the icon.

name: icon_tooltip=
purpose: Sets the icon Tooltip, this string will appear when the mouse is over the icon.

name: message
purpose: Gets the message as string.

name: message=
purpose: Sets a new message.

name: on_accept
purpose: Shows a button in the notification with the given title and callback block, both arguments are required.

name: on_accept_title
purpose: Returns the accept’s button title.

name: on_dismiss
purpose: Shows a button in the notification with the given title and callback block.

name: on_dismiss_title
purpose: Returns the dismiss’s button title.

name: show
purpose: Shows the notification.

name: new
purpose: The new method creates a new Toolbar object.

name: add_item
purpose: The add_item method is used to add an item to the toolbar.

name: add_separator
purpose: The add_separator method is used to add a line separator to the toolbar.

name: count
purpose: The #count method is inherited from the Enumerable mix-in module.

name: each
purpose: The #each method is used to iterate through all of the commands attached to a toolbar.

name: get_last_state
purpose: The get_last_state method is used to determine if the toolbar was hidden or visible in the previous session of SketchUp.

name: hide
purpose: The hide method is used to hide the toolbar on the user interface.

name: length
purpose: The #length method returns the number of items in the toolbar.

name: name
purpose: The name method returns the name of the toolbar.

name: restore
purpose: The restore method is used to reposition the toolbar to its previous location and show if not hidden.

name: show
purpose: The show method is used to display the toolbar in the user interface.

name: size
purpose: The #size method is an alias of #length.

name: visible?
purpose: The visible? method is used to find out if a toolbar is currently visible.

name: initialize
purpose: The new method is used to create a new webdialog.
syntax: ["#initialize(dialog_title = \"\", scrollable = true, pref_key = nil, width = 250, height = 250, left = 0, top = 0, resizable = true) ⇒ UI::WebDialog", "#initialize(properties) ⇒ UI::WebDialog"]

name: add_action_callback
purpose: The add_action_callback method establishes a Ruby callback method that your web dialog can call to perform some function.

name: allow_actions_from_host
purpose: By default, actions are only allowed on the host where the webdialog is displayed.

name: bring_to_front
purpose: The bring_to_front method is used to bring the webdialog to the front of all the windows on the desktop.

name: close
purpose: The close method is used to close the webdialog.

name: execute_script
purpose: The execute_script method is used to execute a JavaScript string on the web dialog.

name: get_default_dialog_color
purpose: The get_default_dialog_color method is used to get the default dialog color for the web dialog.

name: get_element_value
purpose: The get_element_value method is used to get a value, with a given element_id, from the web dialog’s DOM.

name: max_height
purpose: The max_height method is used to get the maximum height that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: max_height=
purpose: The max_height= method is used to set the maximum height that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: max_width
purpose: The max_width method is used to get the maximum width that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: max_width=
purpose: The max_width= method is used to set the maximum width that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: min_height
purpose: The min_width method is used to get the minimum height that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: min_height=
purpose: The min_height= method is used to set the minimum height that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: min_width
purpose: The min_width method is used to get the minimum width that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: min_width=
purpose: The min_width= method is used to set the minimum width that the user is allowed to resize the dialog to.

name: navigation_buttons_enabled=
purpose: The navigation_buttons_enabled= method is used to set whether the home, next, and back buttons are visible at the top of the WebDialog on the mac.

name: navigation_buttons_enabled?
purpose: The navigation_buttons_enabled? method is used to get whether the home, next, and back buttons are visible at the top of the WebDialog on the mac. This method has no use on the PC, as these buttons are never displayed.

name: post_url
purpose: The post_url method is used to send the data to a url using the HTTP POST method.

name: screen_scale_factor
purpose: The screen_scale_factor method returns the ratio of screen pixels to logical window units (called ‘points’ on Mac) for the screen this WebDialog is currently in.

name: set_background_color
purpose: The set_background_color method is used to set the background color for the webdialog.

name: set_file
purpose: The #set_file method is used to identify a local HTML file to display in the webdialog.

name: set_full_security
purpose: The set_full_security method is used to place the WebDialog into a higher security mode where remote URLs and plugins (such as Flash) are not allowed inside the browser.

name: set_html
purpose: The set_html method is used to load a webdialog with a string of provided HTML.

name: set_on_close
purpose: The set_on_close method is used to establish one or more activities to perform when the dialog closes (such as saving values stored in the dialog).

name: set_position
purpose: The set_position method is used to set the position of the webdialog relative to the screen, in pixels.

name: set_size
purpose: The set_size method is used to set the size of the webdialog, in pixels.

name: set_url
purpose: The set_url method is used to load a webdialog with the content at a specific URL.

name: show
purpose: The show method is used to display a non-modal dialog box.

name: show_modal
purpose: The show_modal method is used to display a modal dialog box.

name: visible?
purpose: The visible? method is used to tell if the webdialog is currently shown.

name: write_image
purpose: The write_image method is used to grab a portion of the web dialog screen and save the image to the given file path.
syntax: ["#write_image(image_path, option, top_left_x, top_left_y, bottom_right_x, bottom_right_y) ⇒ Object"]
